name: B12
description_en:
B12 is a hosted AI builder for websites, stores and web apps. Describe a project, refine the generated draft through chat or visual editing, and publish it; paid plans add custom domains, backends and commerce. Its client-engagement tier adds intake, contact management, email marketing, contracts and eSignatures around that public website.

Evaluate B12 as an ongoing hosted service with AI usage allowances. A free subdomain can support exploration and a basic launch, while a branded domain, more launched projects and client tools require the relevant subscription. Human setup services have different fees and downgrade conditions.
description_zh:
B12 是托管式 AI 网站、商店和 Web 应用构建工具。用户描述项目，通过聊天或可视化编辑修改生成草稿，再发布上线；付费方案增加自定义域名、后端和电商功能。客户互动方案在网站之外增加客户资料收集、联系人、邮件营销、合同和电子签名。

应把 B12 作为带 AI 用量额度的持续托管服务评估。免费子域名适合探索和基础上线；品牌域名、更多已发布项目及客户工具需要相应订阅。人工建站服务另有费用和降级限制。

core_features.explanation_en: Generate a draft from a description and request layout, copy or backend changes through the AI Agent; visual editing provides another way to target elements.
core_features.explanation_zh: 根据描述生成草稿，通过 AI Agent 请求布局、文案或后端修改，也可用可视化编辑选择具体元素。

core_features.explanation_en: The higher self-service tier adds intake, email, contacts, contracts and file uploads; these are not all included in the Free plan.
core_features.explanation_zh: 较高自助方案增加客户资料收集、邮件、联系人、合同和文件上传，并非免费方案全部包含。

core_features.explanation_en: Connect an existing domain without normally transferring registration, or register through IONOS with a conditional first-year offer.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通常可保留原注册商连接已有域名，也可通过 IONOS 注册并使用有条件的首年优惠。

pricing.summary_en: Free hosted subdomain tier; displayed Website $24/month and Website + Client Engagement $78/month, with AI/project allowances. Billing term/currency code need checkout confirmation; domain renewal and expert setup can add costs.
pricing.summary_zh: 提供免费托管子域名方案；Website 显示 $24/月，客户互动方案显示 $78/月，带 AI/项目额度。周期与货币代码需结账确认，域名续费及专家设置可能另费。

sections.title_en: From a business brief to a launchable draft
sections.title_zh: 从业务需求到待发布草稿
sections.en: A useful brief names the audience, pages, desired action and any app or store behavior. B12 describes a three-step flow: describe, edit, launch. Inspect generated claims, navigation and form behavior before publishing. Its examples include portfolios, stores and expense trackers, but a generated example does not establish that an arbitrary production application will satisfy security or operational requirements. For an existing site, B12 recommends a fresh build rather than promising a complete import.
sections.zh: 可用需求应写明受众、页面、期望行动以及应用或商店行为。B12 描述的流程是描述、编辑、发布。发布前应检查生成内容的事实、导航和表单行为。官网示例包含作品集、商店和费用跟踪器，但示例不证明任意生产应用都能满足安全或运营要求。对于已有网站，B12 建议重新构建，并未承诺完整导入。

sections.title_en: Match credits and client tools to the work
sections.title_zh: 按额度和客户工具选择方案
sections.en: The captured self-service table lists Free at $0 on a b12sites.com subdomain, with 5 daily AI credits capped at 30 per month. Website is displayed at $24/month with 100 monthly credits and up to 10 launched projects; Website + Client Engagement at $78/month has 300 credits and up to 30 launched projects. The latter adds custom email, intake, email marketing, contact management, contracts/eSignatures and uploads. The page exposes monthly/yearly selectors without an unambiguous selected billing state in this text capture, so verify the checkout term and currency code instead of treating these as a normalized annual quote.
sections.zh: 实读自助方案表列出 Free 为 $0，使用 b12sites.com 子域名，每天 5 个 AI 额度、每月最多 30 个。Website 显示 $24/月，含每月 100 额度和最多 10 个已发布项目；Website + Client Engagement 显示 $78/月，含 300 额度和最多 30 个已发布项目。后者增加自定义邮件、客户资料收集、邮件营销、联系人、合同/电子签名及上传。页面提供月付/年付切换，但文本未明确选中状态，因此应核对结账周期和货币代码，不将其归一为确定的年付报价。

sections.title_en: Publish on a domain you control
sections.title_zh: 使用自己控制的域名发布
sections.en: Custom-domain publishing requires Website or above. In Domains, choose Connect existing domain, enter the www domain, optionally mark it primary, then sync and authorize the registrar connection. B12 says the primary-domain setting adds canonical tags. Automatic DNS updates require access to the domain-provider account; manual DNS instructions are the fallback. The editor can take hours to show Connected and the site may take 24–48 hours to appear. Keep existing mail records and business continuity in the migration checklist; this research did not change any DNS.
sections.zh: 自定义域名发布要求 Website 或更高方案。在 Domains 中选择连接已有域名，填写 www 域名，按需设为主域名，然后同步并授权注册商连接。B12 表示主域名设置会添加 canonical 标签。自动更新 DNS 需要域名服务商账户权限，失败时可按文档手动设置。编辑器显示已连接可能需要数小时，网站通过域名可访问可能需要 24–48 小时。迁移检查应包含原有邮件记录和业务连续性；本次研究没有修改 DNS。

sections.title_en: Separate the trial, domain renewal and human help
sections.title_zh: 区分试用、域名续费和人工服务
sections.en: The $1-for-7-days offer is a new-user introductory offer, not the continuing subscription price. One custom domain is free only for the first year, subject to availability and pricing exclusions. Registration happens at IONOS, requires a card for next-year renewal and may require verification; IONOS bills later renewals. Expert Marketplace work and the do-it-for-you setup package are separate from routine subscription support. The FAQ allows Website and Website + Client Engagement customers to move between those tiers or Free, but says Professional/Advanced customers cannot downgrade to those self-service tiers. Resolve setup fees and exit terms before choosing the human-led package.
sections.zh: 新用户首 7 天 $1 是入门优惠，不是持续订阅价。一个自定义域名仅首年免费，受可用性和价格排除条件限制。注册在 IONOS 完成，需要提供银行卡用于次年续费，也可能需要验证；后续续费由 IONOS 收取。Expert Marketplace 工作和代建站设置包与常规订阅支持分开。FAQ 允许 Website 与客户互动方案互换或降为 Free，但指出 Professional/Advanced 客户不能降到这些自助方案。选择人工服务前应确认设置费和退出条款。

sections.title_en: Where B12 fits and what remains to prove
sections.title_zh: 适用边界与仍需验证的事项
sections.en: B12 is a plausible shortlist for a service business that wants a hosted public site and integrated client intake with limited infrastructure administration. A team that needs to own a deployable codebase, run entirely on its own servers or migrate a complex application should first obtain explicit export, backend, data-portability and service-limit documentation. These sources establish SaaS access, not an open-source license or self-hosting entitlement. Test a representative page, form, payment path and domain connection in an account before committing a business-critical workflow; no such account or payment test was performed here.
sections.zh: 对于希望减少基础设施管理、同时获得公开网站与客户资料收集的服务企业，B12 值得进入候选清单。需要拥有可部署代码、自有服务器运行或迁移复杂应用的团队，应先取得明确的导出、后端、数据可迁移性和服务限制文档。这些来源确认 SaaS 访问方式，没有确立开源许可或自托管权利。将关键业务迁入前应在账户内验证代表性页面、表单、支付链和域名连接；本次没有进行账户或付款测试。
